name: mikuos
description: mikuOS 0.3, a Unix-like system built on the Thistle kernel.

scripts.build: npm run stage:thistle && npm run build:thistle:staged && npm run teto:build:staged
scripts.build:thistle: npm run stage:thistle && npm run build:thistle:staged
scripts.teto:build: npm run stage:thistle && npm run teto:build:staged
scripts.teto:validate: npm --prefix deps/teto install --package-lock=false && npm --prefix deps/teto run build
scripts.test: npm run build && bun scripts/ci/stage-thistle-native.mts --check && node build/test/all.js
scripts.test:guest-toolchain: npm run build && THISTLE_FUEL=0 node build/test/toolchain.js
scripts.test:bun: npm run build && bun run build/test/bun.js
scripts.serve:web: npm run build && bun run build/main/server.js
scripts.teto:test:web: npm run build && bun run build/main/server.js
scripts.stage:thistle: git submodule update --init deps/teto && git -C deps/teto submodule update --init thistle && bun scripts/ci/stage-thistle-native.mts
scripts.build:thistle:staged: npm run clean && npm run guards:staged && npm run check:scripts && tsc -p tsconfig.json && node build/tool/post.js
scripts.teto:build:staged: npm --prefix deps/teto install --package-lock=false && npm --prefix deps/teto run build && mkdir -p dist/teto && cp deps/teto/dist/teto/* dist/teto/ && if [ -f build/tool/teto-web.js ] && [ -f dist/web/index.html ]; then node build/tool/teto-web.js; fi
scripts.guards: npm run stage:thistle && npm run guards:staged
scripts.guards:staged: git submodule update --init -- code-guards && npm --prefix code-guards install --package-lock=false --no-audit --no-fund && bash scripts/ci/guards.sh
